2645-3181-3430-3756.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

765-2085-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2085-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4826-5531-5694-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-5531-5694-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-5531-5694-6927-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

6797-7940--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

880-6763-7893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-7893.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5400-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5400-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Synth Infiltrator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5400-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

676-1987-3277.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-3277.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-3277.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3080-3908-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
193-2724-3080-3908-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

582-1409-2097.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7156.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-6965.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-6965.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

2607-2615.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2607-2615.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
2607-2615.notes: If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

141-2511-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

719-2060-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
719-2060-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Crystalline Crawler for additional mana.

2743-6231-6471.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-6231-6471.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6231-6471.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Will of the Temur at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Will of the Temur spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

222-527-4050-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2178-4681-5231-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

618-2438-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1818-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1818-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Healer of the Pride indestructible.
1818-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

245-2440.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers and Mana Echoes triggers twice.
Resolve the Marneus Calgar trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Astartes Warrior you control.
Repeat.

2068-2232-3907-5502.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
2068-2232-3907-5502.description:
Activate Akul the Unrepentant by sacrificing three creatures.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Akul the Unrepentant's ability.
Resolve the copy of Akul the Unrepentant's ability, putting Underworld Hermit from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Underworld Hermit enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Underworld Hermit trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
When the Squirrels enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from step 4, returning Akul the Unrepentant from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Akul the Unrepentant's ability from step 1, putting it onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Akul the Unrepentant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Underworld Hermit from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-4102-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4102-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3075-3368-4539.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three experience counters.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
3075-3368-4539.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card from your hand.
If you have less than four experience counters, Mizzix triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Retierate with buyback by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Unexpected Windfall and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

849-2034-3240-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Anax, crating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Satyr token, adding {C}{C}.
The Satyr dies, triggering Nether Traitor, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
